steps.text: Use only the commerce tools. Call commerce_load_sample, then commerce_get_listing for P-100. Stage one price change for P-100 to 21.90 with the summary 'Raise jasmine tea to 21.90'. Then call commerce_export_changes with that change id and platform sample. I will reject the permission prompt; after the rejection, do not retry and do not work around it. Reply with the single word REJECTED and stop.
